messages.subject: ProjectTemplate and Shiny (deployment)
parts:
Hi all!

I am wondering whether I can develop a Shiny app within a broader project context (i.e. a multi-level/-folder project hierarchy) and use selected resources from that project for the Shiny app.

In my particular case, I have just started working on a first small project to develop a bit of a routine in working with R. I came across ProjectTemplate (http://projecttemplate.net/) and used it to set up my project and distribute files across its suggested hierarchy (see it here http://projecttemplate.net/getting_started.html).

After getting the basics of my analysis to work, I decided to also build a Shiny app for my analysis. I placed it in src/shiny as a single app.R file. Seeing how I had developed my data processing in other files before, I started including bits of my previous work via source("../../munge/xyz.R")and the like.

Now it seems to me that this will not really work when I try to deploy either just my app.R file or the whole project hierarchy via shinyapps::deployApp().

Is it at all possible to build Shiny apps based on such a project structure and deploy them from within it? Or do I always have to copy any processing I have previously developed manually (and then keep it in sync) when I want to publish it as a Shiny app?

Best
Matt

P.S.: This seems to go in a similar direction as Nicola's question here: https://groups.google.com/d/msg/shiny-discuss/ibAXs3zLWAs/-S1_OZIDEwAJ
